channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PF cita Jaques Wagner em possível visita a ilha ligada ao Master
item.description: The Federal Police cited Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) in a report from Operation Compliance Zero, indicating that he and his wife visited Ilha da Paixão in October 2023, a property linked to Augusto Ferreira Lima, former partner of Banco Master. The PF relied on messages, flight records, and photographs from seized cell phones, including an audio from Wagner confirming the invitation and a thank-you message from his wife after the visit. The investigation was made public by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça on July 30, 2026.

item.title: Uma boa e uma má notícia para Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received a favorable signal from Senator Tereza Cristina as a potential running mate, but simultaneously had to replace his campaign manager for the third time in a few months, revealing instability in campaign communications. The situation highlights the Bolsonaro family's tendency to directly intervene in communications, causing operational chaos.

item.title: Cinco razões que levam Tereza Cristina a ser uma boa opção para Flávio
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler outlines five reasons why Tereza Cristina would be a strong vice-presidential pick for Flávio Bolsonaro in 2026: her prominence as a female leader, strong ties to agribusiness, Congressional articulation skills, seniority and institutional weight, and the potential for a strategic party alliance. He notes that Centrão leaders have previously criticized Bolsonaro’s 2022 choice of Braga Netto, implying Tereza Cristina would have been a better option.

item.title: Fracasso do Move Brasil e extensão do Desenrola expõem interesse eleitoreiro
item.description: The Move Brazil program, launched with R$ 30 billion to subsidize vehicle purchases for taxi drivers, app-based drivers, delivery workers, and cyclists, achieved very low uptake, with disbursements near R$ 3 billion and realistic projections between R$ 5 and R$ 6 billion. President Lula criticized banks for the low adhesion, but analysts argue the failure stems from flawed program design, not just financial institutions’ actions. The initiative is seen as having electoral motives, given its timing ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: É difícil combater desconfiança no sistema eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed distrust in Brazil’s electoral system during an event with diplomats, prompting international attention. According to the Washington Post, the Trump administration dispatched two State Department advisers to Brazil to assess the integrity of the electoral process. The issue of confidence in electronic voting machines is once again becoming central to political discourse in the country.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro troca marqueteiro, mas parece precisar de um milagreiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro fired his second campaign strategist in two months, highlighting ongoing struggles in his 2026 electoral bid. The personnel change reflects an attempt to improve weak polling numbers, though analysts suggest the challenges may extend beyond messaging to deeper structural or reputational issues.

item.title: Com aval de Valdemar e novo marqueteiro, Flávio tenta resgatar estratégia de Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro hired Duda Lima, the marketer behind Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign, with the endorsement of PL president Valdemar Costa Neto, to reorganize his 2026 presidential strategy. The move aims to restore disciplined, theme-based communication — including weekly live streams and electoral system critiques — after weeks of reactive crisis management without a clear narrative. Allies emphasize the goal is not to replicate 2022 but to adapt its logic to the current context, integrating TV, radio, social media, and press around a few core themes.

item.title: Missão realiza congresso com ingressos de até R$ 8.014 em SP
item.description: The Mission party will hold its 1st Congress in São Paulo on August 1, 2026, with tickets ranging from R$ 94 to R$ 8.014, presenting the presidential candidacy of Renan Santos, already officially nominated. The event includes VIP access, autographs, lunch with party leaders, and Federal Police protection due to threats from criminal factions. Additional congresses are scheduled in Curitiba and Joinville with varied pricing and free admission for party members.

item.title: Kataguiri chama Eduardo de “patético” e o desafia: “Vem me bater”
item.description: Deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) responded to former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP), who said he had the 'desire to beat up these guys [from MBL]', by calling Eduardo a 'coward' and challenging him to a physical confrontation during an interview on MathiasTV. Kataguiri also criticized Eduardo's self-exile in the United States, accusing him of fleeing at the first sign of possible arrest after his June 2026 conviction by the STF to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the course of justice.

item.title: Cidades e Transportes são áreas mais beneficiadas por liberação de R$ 5,7 bi do orçamento
item.description: The Lula government released R$ 5.7 billion from the annual budget, primarily benefiting the Ministries of Cities (R$ 1.2 billion) and Transport (R$ 1.015 billion), due to reduced spending on pensions, BPC, and personnel. The funds were unblocked ahead of the 2026 election campaign, with part allocated to parliamentary amendments.

item.title: Mudou de cor? Quatro anos após polêmica ACM Neto se declara branco ao TSE
item.description: Four years after controversy over declaring himself pardo in 2022, ACM Neto changed his racial self-declaration to white in the TSE for the 2026 elections, reigniting identity debates. His wealth also increased by 103.5% over the period, rising from R$ 41.7 million to R$ 84.9 million, with notable growth in real estate funds and a new apartment in Barra Grande.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro travam batalha decisiva no Sudeste, com disputas embaralhadas nos estados
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are locked in a decisive battle for control of Brazil’s three largest electoral colleges — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — according to a new Genial/Quaest poll. The contest reflects national polarization, with the Southeast as the central battleground between the PT government and Bolsonarist opposition.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio com novo marqueteiro terá ajustes, e não guinada direitista, dizem integrantes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign stated that the change in marketing advisors was driven by professional reasons, such as lack of organization and misalignment with political leadership, denying any ideological shift to the right. Campaign members emphasized that the adjustment aims to improve operational efficiency, not to alter the campaign's ideological direction.

item.title: Impasse entre TSE e STF trava eleição para Governo de Roraima
item.description: The gubernatorial election in Roraima remains unresolved following a supplementary election held on June 21, due to a disagreement between the TSE and STF over the validity of results or interim measures. The lack of consensus between the two high courts is preventing the inauguration of the winner and creating political uncertainty in the state. This jurisdictional impasse is blocking the normalization of the local electoral process.

item.title: Kassab explica por que não vai à convenção que indicará Tarcísio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado’s ticket, explained why he will not attend the Republicans’ convention that will formally nominate Tarcísio de Freitas. He stated his absence is due to party and strategic commitments aligned with his own candidacy. The event, set for August 1st, will formally establish Tarcísio as the Republicans’ candidate for governor of São Paulo.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa impacto de Milei e decisão de Moraes na disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election examines how recent events — such as Javier Milei’s endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro, Alexandre de Moraes’ ruling restricting visits to Jair Bolsonaro, and potential Trump support — may influence voter intentions between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey also evaluates government approval, economic perception, institutional trust, and other political and social issues.

item.title: Lulinha e a PF: Mendonça dá um presentão a Flávio, é claro!
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized an inquiry into Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, over alleged lobbying access to presidential and health ministry officials. The investigation, tied to the INSS scandal, is seen as an effort to implicate President Lula, while Bolsonaro allies use it to mirror Flávio Bolsonaro’s own legal troubles. The move is framed as a political gift to Flávio’s campaign, creating a narrative of mutual persecution.

item.title: “Não tem nada de errado”, diz Flávio sobre vídeo de Jair feito com IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the legality of the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention, stating that his team reviewed TSE rules and found no violation due to the upfront disclosure about AI use. He said the video only asks for support for his candidacy and that Jair Bolsonaro had no prior knowledge of its production. The remarks came after Alexandre de Moraes ordered the defense to clarify whether the former president authorized the image use, warning that lack of consent could shift liability to Flávio’s campaign and the PL.

item.title: Lula chama Eduardo Bolsonaro de “filho do satanás”
item.description: In an interview with the podcast Inteligência Ltda., President Lula called Eduardo Bolsonaro 'son of Satan', accusing him of working against Brazil from the United States due to his ties with the Trump administration and his role in promoting the 2025 tariff increase. Lula further claimed that Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio would attempt to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections to favor Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, and criticized Rubio for his Cuban heritage and alleged anti-Latin America stance.

item.title: “Ja imaginaram se fosse filho do Bolsonaro?”, diz Flávio sobre Lulinha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, criticized the Federal Police for lacking resources to investigate Lulinha, son of President Lula, who is suspected of influence peddling and corruption in dealings with lobbyist 'Careca do INSS'. He questioned whether Jair Bolsonaro's son would face the same lax investigation if accused of diverting pensioners' funds. Flávio announced a new live stream on August 6 to clarify the PL's state-level alliances and reduce voter confusion.

item.title: O revés para Flávio Bolsonaro no episódio com Milei
item.description: Javier Milei's participation in the PL convention, featuring aggressive remarks against Lula and Alexandre de Moraes, triggered strong negative backlash on social media, halting Flávio Bolsonaro's digital momentum. According to Alek Maracajá, CEO of Ativaweb, over 188,000 messages were captured and more than 80% of Brazilians rejected Milei's stance, which was deemed extremely polemical and poorly strategic for the senator.

item.title: EUA querem que América Latina seja seu quintal e vão interferir nas eleições, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva claimed that the United States intends to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections to favor Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, his main political opponent. Lula described the alleged action as an attempt to turn Latin America into the 'backyard' of the U.S., denouncing foreign interference in Brazil's democratic process.

item.title: Lula diz que EUA vão tentar interferir no Brasil para ajudar Flávio Bolsonaro a ganhar eleições
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said the U.S. government under Donald Trump will attempt to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections to favor Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, though he remains unbothered, claiming Brazil will win the narrative battle by exposing lies. He also condemned 100-year secrecy on government documents, arguing nothing deserves absolute secrecy, and renewed his focus on national defense following Trump-era actions.

item.title: Depois do Trump, estou obcecado pela defesa, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said he became 'obsessed' with national defense following actions by the U.S. government under Donald Trump. He made the comment in an interview with Podcast Inteligência Ltda., stating that Trump's approach led him to prioritize Brazil's defense and security.

item.title: Lulinha “jura todo dia que é inocente”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), 'swears every day that he is innocent' regarding investigations into alleged influence peddling. He emphasized that Lulinha will not receive preferential treatment if held accountable. The remarks were made in an interview on Thursday, January 30.

item.title: Lula sobre investigação de Lulinha: "Não vou utilizar o cargo para proteger"
item.description: President Lula stated he will not use his position to protect his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), who is under investigation by the Federal Police for corruption and influence peddling related to medicinal cannabis. He emphasized there will be no privileges and that his son will face justice if convicted. The inquiry was authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça following allegations of lobbying by 'Careca do INSS' and R$1.5 million in payments to Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha.

item.title: Em convenção, PCdoB oficializa apoio à reeleição de Lula
item.description: The Communist Party of Brazil (PCdoB) officially endorsed President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) re-election bid during its National Electoral Convention, held virtually on July 30, 2024. The party also confirmed support for maintaining Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) on the ticket and authorized adjustments in electoral negotiations, solidifying its integration into the Brazil of Hope Federation coalition.

item.title: "Não tinha ideia": Flávio nega ciência de Bolsonaro sobre vídeo de IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, had any knowledge of the AI-generated video shown during the PL national convention, stating the ex-president 'had no idea' it would be displayed. He argued that the use of AI did not violate TSE rules, claiming the technology is widely used on social media and cannot be effectively monitored. The former president's defense also denied prior authorization for the use of his image and voice in the video.

item.title: Lula diz que Lulinha não vai se esconder caso seja julgado
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that his son, Fabio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), will not hide if investigated and will be treated like any other citizen, without privileges. Lula emphasized he will not interfere in judicial decisions and that Lulinha must face the consequences of his actions. The remarks come after Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized an inquiry into Lulina for alleged influence peddling and corruption related to lobbying for medicinal cannabis contracts with the Ministry of Health.

item.title: Federação União-PP em Pernambuco ‘não admite’ apoio a Flávio
item.description: The União-PP federation in Pernambuco, led by federal deputy Dudu da Fonte, reaffirmed its neutrality in the presidential race and ruled out any support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, despite ongoing efforts to include Senator Tereza Cristina as his running mate.

item.title: Lula: “Os filhos do Satanás foram para os EUA lutar contra o Brasil”
item.description: President Lula stated that the 'children of Satan' went to the United States to work against Brazil, referring to former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro and his alleged efforts with the U.S. government to advocate for economic sanctions against the country. The remark was made on Thursday, the 30th, during a public event. Lula accused the opposition of collaborating with foreign interests to harm the nation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Jair não sabia de vídeo de IA e defende uso: 'Nós estudamos a legislação'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Jair Bolsonaro was unaware of the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention that formalized his 2026 presidential candidacy. He defended the use of AI, saying the campaign’s legal team studied the law and that the video included a clear disclaimer stating it was AI-generated, with no intent to deceive. The PT has filed a complaint with the TSE against Flávio and the PL, while Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes questioned whether Jair authorized the video’s dissemination.

item.title: Flávio: Falta braço da PF para investigar Lulinha; imagina se fosse filho de Bolsonaro?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the Federal Police's investigations into Lulinha, son of President Lula, claiming lack of resources and questioning whether the same scrutiny would apply if Bolsonaro's son were suspected. He announced a live broadcast on November 6 to confirm the PL's state-level slates, aiming to reduce voter confusion. Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça authorized an inquiry into Lulinha for alleged influence peddling.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Trump é o "maior líder fascista do século 21"
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva labeled Donald Trump the 'greatest fascist leader of the 21st century' and described his actions as 21st-century imperialism tied to economic disputes, tariffs, and control of natural resources. He stated that Lula's re-election signifies democracy's victory over fascism and advocated prioritizing sovereignty over critical minerals, industrialization, and public security. The remark was made in a video sent to the PCdoB national convention, which formalized support for Lula's re-election.

item.title: Lula diz que recebeu sugestão para fugir do país durante a Lava Jato
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that during his imprisonment in Operation Lava Jato, he received suggestions to seek refuge in an embassy and flee the country, but chose to remain in Brazil. He contrasted his decision with that of the 'honest' sons of former president Jair Bolsonaro, whom he claimed would have left the country under similar circumstances.

item.title: Justiça mantém condenação de homem que tentou explodir bomba perto do Aeroporto de Brasília
item.description: The Federal District Court upheld the conviction of Wellington Macedo de Souza to six years in prison, in an initial closed regime, for aggravated explosion. He was part of a group of supporters of former President Jair Bolsonaro who attempted to detonate a bomb near Brasília’s airport to create chaos and facilitate a military intervention against the inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Mendonça vê risco de vazamento depois pedido de Wagner para reunião
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça made public the investigations against Senator Jaques Wagner in the Compliance Zero probe into Banco Master fraud. Mendonça ruled to archive the Federal Police's petition, stating its evidentiary purpose was exhausted, and ordered the release of all documents in PET 16.210. Wagner, former Senate government leader, was targeted in search warrants in June as part of the operation’s ninth phase.

item.title: Governistas questionam investigação de Lulinha e “blindagem” a Flávio
item.description: Lula's allies criticize Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça's decision to authorize a Federal Police investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over influence peddling allegations. They argue that similar scrutiny was not applied to Flávio Bolsonaro, despite evidence of negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', calling it a 'blind shield' for Lula's main 2026 election rival. While disagreeing with the Lulinha probe, they emphasize that the Federal Police's action demonstrates institutional independence and absence of presidential interference.

item.title: Caiado anuncia Aldo Rebelo como coordenador político da campanha
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado announced Aldo Rebelo as the political coordinator of his presidential campaign, reinforcing the strategy to broaden dialogue with various societal segments. The decision was made in a meeting with Gilberto Kassab and Heráclito Fortes, following Rebelo’s failed presidential bid with the DC party, which ended in internal party conflict.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula age como “rei” em “monarquia disfarçada de república”
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized President Lula, saying he acts like a 'king' in a 'monarchy disguised as a republic,' in response to the STF's decision authorizing the PF to investigate Lulinha on influence trafficking suspicions.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio por suposta rede de perfis contra Lula
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) filed a complaint with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), alleging he is expanding a network of anonymous or fake profiles criticizing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The party seeks to hold him accountable for the publications attributed to this network.

item.title: Advogado de Lulinha critica novo inquérito: "Pesca probatória"
item.description: The lawyer for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, criticized the opening of a new police investigation against President Lula's son, calling it a 'fishing expedition'. He stated that prior investigations into the INSS scheme found no evidence linking Lulinha to the case and that the new inquiry, authorized by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, will examine alleged corruption and influence peddling in the Health Ministry related to medicinal cannabis business.

item.title: Ala do TSE reclama de omissão de Nunes Marques e interferência de Moraes no caso da IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE ministers privately complain about undue interference by Alexandre de Moraes in the AI video debate involving Bolsonaro and the omission of Kassio Nunes Marques, who has not yet ruled on the case challenging the PL’s use of an AI-generated Bolsonaro video. They argue Nunes Marques should have decided the matter promptly or publicly defended Brazil’s electronic voting system in recent incidents, including Flávio Bolsonaro’s claims about urn manufacturing and a U.S. delegation’s request for a TSE visit.

item.title: Zema acusa Aro de “traição” em Minas
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) accused his former Chief of Staff, Marcelo Aro (PP), of "betrayal" after Aro became the leading right-wing candidate for the 2026 state gubernatorial race. The statement was made in a video released on social media following the withdrawal of Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) from the election. Zema criticized Aro for leaving his administration and now leading the opposition to his potential re-election.

item.title: Lula se reunirá com Alcolumbre para destravar 6 X 1
item.description: President Lula will meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to advance the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key flag for his 2026 re-election bid. Despite ongoing negotiations, approval before the first round (October 4) is seen as difficult due to tensions stemming from the rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF. The Public Security PEC also remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio faz live após mudanças na comunicação de sua campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is hosting a YouTube live at 7:30 p.m. this Thursday (July 30, 2026), shortly after his campaign announced staffing changes, including the appointment of publicist Duda Lima as the new communications chief, replacing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer. During the broadcast, he is expected to comment on national politics and answer audience questions.

item.title: Mendonça autoriza investigação contra Lulinha por suspeita de tráfico de influência
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the opening of an investigation into alleged influence peddling involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The probe stems from evidence gathered in another case concerning improper INSS discounts, in which Lulinha is already a subject.

item.title: Janaina exalta “predicados” de Tereza Cristina: “Voto de olhos fechados”
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Janaina Paschoal praised Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), stating she has 'all the qualities' to be president of the Republic and that her presence as vice president would 'enhance any ticket'. The statement was made amid rumors that Tereza Cristina could join Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential ticket in the 2026 election.

item.title: Inquérito contra Lulinha é resposta da PF às críticas da oposição e do STF
item.description: The Federal Police opened an inquiry against Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula, following opposition and STF criticism over the lack of a specific investigation. Minister André Mendonça authorized the inquiry and was appointed as rapporteur. The probe focuses on alleged influence peddling in the health sector, unrelated to the INSS scandal, after revealing R$19.5 million in bank transactions between 2022 and 2026.

item.title: Cúpula do PP rechaça possibilidade de Tereza Cristina ser vice de Flávio
item.description: The PP leadership rejected the possibility of Tereza Cristina becoming Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, upholding its decision to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential race. The decision is based on courting the Lula government to secure Ciro Nogueira's re-election in Piauí and avoid complications in other strategic states, along with internal party deadline constraints. Tereza Cristina confirmed she had spoken with Flávio Bolsonaro about the vice presidency but emphasized no decision has been made.
